en: Out by Emerald Station, Mary-Beth is waiting for a race.
zh: 翡翠牧场车站旁，玛丽贝思正在等人和她赛一场。

en: First one to Valentine takes it.
zh: 谁先到瓦伦丁，谁就赢。

en: Beat her to town, and Pearson will be ready to race you.
zh: 抢在她前面进镇，皮尔逊就会接受你的挑战。

en: You'll find him down by the lake. Ride up and ask for a race.
zh: 沿着湖岸就能找到他。骑到他面前，就能约上一场。

en: Word gets around. More riders will take you on as you win.
zh: 消息传开了。赢得越多，愿意应战的骑手也越多。

en: Who else is out there? That's for you to find out.
zh: 荒野里还有谁在等你？留给你亲自去找。

en: In the original game, roadside races dry up once you've earned both rewards.
zh: 在原版里，赢齐两次赛马奖励，路上就再也遇不到邀赛了。

en: The Jockey Club brings those meetings back. The next stranger might want a race.
zh: 赛马会让这些偶遇回来了。下一个跟你搭话的陌生人，也许就想比一场。

en: Keep winning duels, and breed challenges open up.
zh: 一路赢下对决，还会解锁品种限定赛。

en: Bring the breed your host asks for.
zh: 你得骑着对手指定的马种来赴约。

en: Rains Fall wants an American Paint. This horse won't do.
zh: 落雨只接受美国花马。骑眼前这匹，他可不答应。

en: Round the corner in Valentine, and John has a different race in mind.
zh: 转过瓦伦丁的街角，约翰等着和你比另一场。

en: Bring a Thoroughbred, and he'll take you to the starting line.
zh: 这次骑纯血马来，他就会带你上起跑线。

en: Run wide, and you'll get a warning to return to the course.
zh: 跑出赛道后，你会先收到返回路线的警告。

en: Stay out too long and the race is over.
zh: 迟迟不回，就会被判出局。

en: A winning horse can earn its keep long after the race.
zh: 一匹赢过比赛的马，下了赛道也有身价。

en: You'll find the club agent beside the stables near Van Horn.
zh: 范霍恩附近的马厩旁，就能找到赛马会经纪人。

en: He only buys horses with an official win. This one has none.
zh: 他只收赢过正式比赛的马。这匹还没有胜绩。

en: Let's ride back with the Mustang that beat Mary-Beth.
zh: 这次换上赢过玛丽贝思的野马，再来找他。

en: Now you can select Sell Horse. He'll check its race record.
zh: 现在可以选「出售马匹」了。他会调出这匹马的赛绩。

en: There's the win over Mary-Beth. His offer is twenty-two dollars.
zh: 赢玛丽贝思的那一场也记在账上。经纪人报价二十二美元。

en: Sell the club a winner, and you've earned the right to join.
zh: 给赛马会卖出一匹胜马，你才有资格申请入会。

en: A thousand dollars buys membership and opens the betting ring.
zh: 缴一千美元会费就能入会，往后也能在赛场下注。

en: There's an honorary membership, too. I'll leave that one to you.
zh: 俱乐部也设有荣誉会员。怎样取得这个身份，留给你去发现。

en: Start in Valentine, where the bookmaker runs a handicap.
zh: 先到瓦伦丁。这里的庄家办的是让磅赛。

en: The horses share speed and acceleration ratings. Each keeps its own handling.
zh: 各匹马的速度和加速度档位相同，操控手感仍各有差别。

en: I'll put ten dollars on Tilly Jackson to win.
zh: 这一场，我押十美元，赌蒂莉·杰克逊拿第一。

en: A win ticket needs first place. A place ticket pays on the top three.
zh: 独赢得押中冠军，位置票只要押中的骑手跑进前三。

en: Hold the right mouse button to follow your pick. Here comes Tilly.
zh: 按住鼠标右键，镜头会先跟上你押的骑手。看，蒂莉来了。

en: Let go and hold it again to follow another rider.
zh: 松开右键再按住，就能换一名骑手跟拍。

en: Tilly's found a way through. She could actually win this.
zh: 蒂莉找到空当冲上来了。照这样跑，她还真有机会赢。

en: Oh! She clipped the post. And the riders behind have nowhere to go.
zh: 哎！她撞上柱子了，后面跟上来的骑手也躲不开。

en: Tilly's out. There goes our ten.
zh: 蒂莉出局。这十美元也输掉了。

en: Over in Strawberry, they run a weight-for-age race.
zh: 换到草莓镇，这里办的是平磅赛，也叫 Weight for Age。

en: Here the horses keep their own ratings. Take a look down the field.
zh: 这里各匹马按自身属性参赛。翻翻名单，就能看到差别。

en: Let's back Charles Smith this time. Ten dollars to place.
zh: 这回选查尔斯·史密斯。押十美元，赌他跑进前三。

en: Charles has the strongest horse, and he starts at the back.
zh: 查尔斯骑着实力最强的马，从队尾出发。

en: Hold V for the cinematic camera. It opens on your pick, too.
zh: 长按 V 进入电影镜头，最初对准的也是你押的骑手。

en: Watch him work through the field. That's another rider behind him.
zh: 看他从后往前追，又把一名骑手甩在身后。

en: Press C to switch to another rider.
zh: 再按 C，就能切到另一名骑手身上。

en: Second place. Ten dollars down, twenty back.
zh: 第二名。押了十美元，领回二十。

en: Ten dollars clear. Not a bad afternoon in Strawberry.
zh: 净赚十美元。草莓镇的这个下午，过得还不错。

en: The mod comes with Clubhouse. Open it to replay the races you've run.
zh: 模组附带 Clubhouse。运行它，就能回放你跑过的比赛。

en: Follow each rider's line, then watch the speed trace through the turn.
zh: 跟着每名骑手的路线，看他们过弯时的速度曲线。

en: See where a rival sheds speed? That's where you might make a pass.
zh: 对手在哪个弯掉速最明显？那可能就是下次超车的机会。

en: Speed Override widens the gap between a slow horse and a fast one.
zh: 速度覆盖把慢马与快马之间的差距进一步拉开。

en: Low acceleration means a longer run before a horse reaches full speed.
zh: 加速度越低，马就需要越长的距离才能跑到极速。

en: Watch the speed readout at the lower left as the Morgan gets going.
zh: 留意左下角的速度表，看这匹摩根马怎样逐渐提速。

en: At speed level two, the stock Morgan reaches the bridge first.
zh: 速度只有两级时，原版的摩根马先到了桥头。

en: Now give a level-ten Thoroughbred the same stretch of track.
zh: 换一匹十级速度的纯血马，再跑同一段铁轨。

en: This time the override horse pulls away and reaches the bridge first.
zh: 这一次，开启速度覆盖的马拉开了距离，率先抵达桥头。

en: Playing as John, win the earlier duels and all the breed challenges.
zh: 扮演约翰，赢完前面的固定对决和品种挑战。

en: Then take the old trail back to Horseshoe Overlook.
zh: 然后，沿着熟悉的小路，回一趟马掌望台。

en: Somebody's made camp here again. Look at the horses they've brought.
zh: 这里又有人安营了。看看拴在营地边上的都是些什么马。

en: Rare coats. And look at those bars. Ten for speed and ten for acceleration.
zh: 这些毛色可不常见。再看属性，速度十格，加速度也是十格。

en: Who keeps horses like these all the way out here?
zh: 是谁在这个地方，养着这样一群好马？

en: I always wished Arthur had another chance. In this story, he does.
zh: 我一直希望亚瑟能再有一次机会。在这个故事里，他有了。

en: Arthur lived. And there by the fire is Mary Linton, the woman he loves.
zh: 亚瑟活了下来。坐在篝火边的，是他心爱的玛丽·林顿。

en: In John's time, it's Arthur who hosts the Thoroughbred challenge.
zh: 到了约翰的时代，主持纯血马挑战的正是亚瑟。

en: If you remember racing John here, get ready. Arthur rides hard.
zh: 如果你还记得当年和约翰的那一场，这次可得小心。亚瑟快得很。

en: A horse stimulant buys a short burst of speed. It might be just enough.
zh: 马匹兴奋剂能换来短暂的提速。也许就差这一点。

en: One corner left. John is almost level with him.
zh: 还剩最后一个弯。约翰眼看就要和他并驾齐驱了。

en: Arthur takes it by a nose. Two hundred sixty-three dollars, gone.
zh: 亚瑟以微弱优势获胜。这一场，二百六十三美元的赌注也输了。

en: Press F11, open Course Corridor, and turn on Show Optimal Route.
zh: 按 F11 打开菜单，进入赛道边界，开启「显示最佳路线」。

en: Let's try the race again. This time, follow the racing line.
zh: 再跑一次这场比赛。这一回，跟着地上的最佳走线跑。

en: See how the line sets up the turn before the rocks close in?
zh: 看这条线怎样在岩壁收窄之前，提前为入弯留好角度。

en: Beat Arthur's Thoroughbred challenge, and he'll offer one last duel.
zh: 赢下亚瑟的纯血马挑战，他还会邀你进行最后一场对决。

en: You get to pick his horse. This time, let's give him Buell.
zh: 这次由你来给他挑马。就让亚瑟骑布埃尔吧。

en: Come ride with us in The Jockey Club.
zh: 欢迎下载《The Jockey Club》，来和我们一起赛马。

en: Download and source links are in the pinned comment.
zh: 下载地址和开源代码链接，见置顶评论。
